examples.detection_method: Implement email authentication checks (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) to identify spoofed sender domains; monitor domain registrations for lookalike domains; deploy advanced deepfake audio detection integrated with VoIP infrastructure; correlate email and call metadata with user activity logs for anomalous financial transaction triggers; train employees to verify sensitive requests via out-of-band methods such as direct phone calls to verified numbers.
